subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Ad Blockers and Tracker Blockers
description: Learn Ad Blockers and Tracker Blockers in one minute.

hook.text: Install an ad blocker. Watch the number of blocked trackers climb to 30, 50, 100 — on a single page.

buildup.text: Ad blockers like uBlock Origin block ads, trackers, and malicious scripts before they load.

discovery.text: Pages load 50% faster with ad blockers. Less tracking code means less data sent about you.

twist.text: Websites fight back. Some block content from ad-block users. Google's Manifest V3 limits blocker power.

climax.text: Ad blockers are the most accessible privacy tool — and the one Big Tech is working hardest to kill.

punchline.text: Block the trackers. They're blocking the blockers.

quiz.question: How does Google's Manifest V3 affect ad blockers?
options: It limits the capability of ad-blocking browser extensions
It makes ad blockers more powerful
It has no effect on ad blockers
